environment: Live HTTP API against PostgreSQL smart_workflow
sourceFingerprint: same connection request body replayed with formal admin, restricted user, invalid token, and malformed JSON
commands: psql direct before/after count for the probe code
curl -i POST /api/iot/connections with four authentication/body variants
positiveAssertions: Admin receives HTTP 200 with code 0 and creates exactly one probe row
Restricted formal user receives HTTP 403 and does not add a row
Invalid bearer receives HTTP 401 and does not add a row
Malformed JSON receives controlled HTTP 400 and does not add a row
The final direct count is exactly one row created by the admin request
negativeAssertions: No unauthorized or malformed request mutates the connection table
